name: patient_has_finding_of_parkinsonism_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has parkinsonism.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of parkinsonism, regardless of etiology.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of parkinsonism.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of parkinsonism.

name: patient_has_finding_of_parkinsonism_now@@etiology_undetermined
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's parkinsonism is of undetermined etiology.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's parkinsonism is of undetermined etiology.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's parkinsonism is of known etiology.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the etiology of the patient's parkinsonism is undetermined.

name: patient_sex_is_male_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is male.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as male.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not male (e.g., female, other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as female.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not female (e.g., male, other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_disease_condition_finding_now@@can_reasonably_be_expected_to_subject_patient_to_unwarranted_risks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current disease, condition, or clinical finding can reasonably be expected to subject the patient to unwarranted risks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any disease, condition, or clinical finding that can reasonably be expected to subject the patient to unwarranted risks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a disease, condition, or clinical finding but it cannot reasonably be expected to subject the patient to unwarranted risks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's disease, condition, or clinical finding can reasonably be expected to subject the patient to unwarranted risks.
